name: INERT_HREF
purpose: Encode the project's hard no-outbound-links constraint as a single shared constant.
rule: HARD CONSTRAINT, by explicit user instruction. EVERY off-domain destination on this site resolves to the inert href `#`. Link text, styling and hover states are unchanged. This is NOT a defect to fix and MUST NOT be 'repaired' by a generator into a real URL.
